##### Project general facts

Arbor View by Ellington is a contemporary residential development located in the family-oriented community of Arjan, offering 171 thoughtfully designed apartments. The architecture reflects a modern and elegant approach, combining clean lines, balanced proportions, and a calm residential setting. Designed to create a comfortable and refined lifestyle, the project provides a peaceful environment while maintaining convenient access to key attractions such as Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden.

The development offers a selection of lifestyle amenities that enhance everyday comfort and wellbeing. Residents benefit from well-planned communal spaces that promote relaxation and a sense of community, along with easy access to nearby leisure, retail, and outdoor attractions. The project’s location within a quiet neighborhood ensures a balanced lifestyle, ideal for both families and individuals seeking a serene yet connected living environment.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, including porcelain tile flooring, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a soft neutral color palette that enhances light and space. The kitchens are designed with integrated islands, quartz countertops, and smart storage solutions, combining functionality with contemporary style. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a residential community located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.

The community also features several parks and playgrounds, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreational opportunities. Arjan is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and the Al Khail Road, making it easy to access other parts of the city.
